versions.changelog:
- 新增初始安装脚本 install.sh，支持一键部署与目录初始化
- 增加 verify_directory_structure.py，实现目录结构自动规范验证
- 强化安全设计，明确最小权限原则与核心配置二次确认保护
- 提供详细定时任务（jobs.json）配置示例，支持 UTC 时区自动任务
- 更新文档结构，拆分安装/权限说明，明确文件与目录要求

self-evolution v1.0.0

- Initial release of a full safe self-evolution workflow for autonomous, safeguarded AI self-improvement.
- Implements daily checks, weekly reviews, safety experiment workflow, user approval gating, health monitoring, auto-backup, and log cleanup.
- All improvements tested in isolation; production changes require explicit user approval and double confirmation for critical files.
- Fully tracks learnings, errors, and requests; supports auto user profiling and intention prediction.
- OpenClaw-ready, plug-and-play with no extra setup needed.
